text.en:
The barangays of Diplahan, Kauswagan, Butong, Sta. Cruz, Lobing, Goling, Songcoya, Lindang
and the sitios of Managong, Tono, Mejo and Tinongtongan in the Municipality of Malangas; the barangays of
Del Monte, Moyo, Guitom, Gaulan, Villacastor, Balangao and Sampole in the Municipality of Buug; and the
barangays of Ditay; Ginoman, Lu-op, Del Pilar, Paradise, Maneja, and Sampole in the Municipality of Siay,
all within the Province of Zamboanga del Sur, are hereby separated from said municipalities and constituted
into a distinct and independent municipality in the same province to be known as the Municipality of
Diplahan. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in Barangay Diplahan.

The Municipality of Diplahan shall be bounded as follows:
"Beginning from point 1, center of La Dicha Bridge; thence 67 degrees 30 minutes southwest, 4,200 meters to
point 2; thence 59 degrees northwest, west, 7,600 meters to point 3; thence due north, 14,700 meters to point
4; thence due east, 7,000 meters to point 5; thence due south, 19,600 meters back to point 1, with an
approximate area of fourteen thousand eight hundred (14,800) hectares."
